title: Why Is Evernorth Holdings (XRPN) Stock Down -10.76% Today?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
* Shares of [XRPN](https://tickeron.com/ticker/XRPN/) fell 10.76% to $9.29, down from the prior session's close of $10.41.
* The primary catalyst was a fresh leg lower in XRP, the digital asset that underpins the company's treasury strategy.
* Secondary pressure came from lingering share-overhang and dilution concerns tied to a large resale registration and a committed equity facility.
* The decline unfolded against a broader risk-off backdrop in digital assets, with XRP-focused ETFs logging their largest outflows in months.
* Traders are watching whether XRP can defend the $1 level and whether the stock stabilizes near its post-listing lows.
